compatibility: same source-side orientation AND same context-path shape AND either literal substitution compatibility or a simultaneous first-order common specialization of all conflicting shared-variable images
scientific_rule: Change only the substitution compatibility relation. Do not synthesize or install a new proof operator. Reproduce the audited 5x5 quotient and report the complete matrix of newly compatible cells under common specialization.

decision_table.NO_MATRIX_RESCUE: common specialization rescues local pairs but no audited class cell becomes compatible
decision_table.COMMON_SPECIALIZATION_MATRIX_RESCUE: one or more previously incompatible 5x5 cells become compatible under common specialization
